resolution.note: lane start carries an uncommitted task record into the new worktree

title: Let krn lane start claim a task created but not yet committed
body:
Outcome: krn lane start --task ID moves an untracked tasks/ID.json from the invoking checkout into the new worktree before claiming.
Why: the worktree is cut from origin/main, so a just-created task fails with exit 65 "task does not exist" and the lead claimed by hand.
Proof: test/cli/lane.test.ts starts a lane in a real temp repo for an untracked task and for a tracked-modified one (refused).
Scope: src/cli/lane.ts and its test only.
